==Description==
'''Snowball''' is an emote obtained from the [[Operation I.C.E Event#Operation I.C.E Battle Pass|Operation I.C.E Battle Pass]]. It was made by Mewious, Jaaziar and fybirr. It does not have music, and it is not looped. The player can move and interact with this emote. However, doing so causes the player to throw a snowball in the direction they clicked or tapped. The snowball itself can be of varying sizes, which depends on how long the player has been making it for. It can be thrown basically instantly, making it rather small, or the player can instead wait a few seconds for it to become a large snowball.

This emote could be obtained at Level 39 of the premium track, where it costs {{Bell|1,410}} or {{Robux|168}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Bell|25,630}} or {{Robux|4,570}}.

==Trivia==
*You can throw a snowball at yourself, causing you to get flung instead.
**This also allows you to access areas in maps or lobbies that you cannot normally reach.
